Signs you may need duct cleaning

  • Dust poofs from supply vents at startup.
  • Musty or stale smell that lingers.
  • Uneven temperatures room to room.
  • Increased dust on furniture a day after cleaning.
  • Allergy flare-ups inside.
  • Recent remodel or drywall work.
  • Pets that shed year-round.
  • Duct registers with visible buildup.

What our duct cleaning looks like

  • Inspection. We look at supply and return vents, the plenum, and accessible duct sections.
  • Containment. We protect floors and furniture. We block off registers to control airflow during cleaning.
  • Negative pressure. We connect a high-powered vacuum to pull debris out of ducts.
  • Agitation. Rotary brushes or air whips loosen stuck dust and light debris inside the ductwork.
  • Source cleaning. We clean the blower compartment and accessible coils if needed during the visit.
  • Sanitizing on request. We can apply duct sanitizing or disinfecting products for both residential and commercial systems.
  • Final check. We run the system, check airflow, and review results with you.

How often should you clean ducts in Chollas Creek? Many homes do fine every 3 to 5 years. If you have pets, allergies, nearby construction, or recent smoke exposure, consider every 2 to 3 years.
